zh.title: ICAO 蒙特婁總部推出航安展覽 聚焦零死亡長期目標
zh.summary: ICAO 在蒙特婁總部博物館推出為期一年的航安展覽，由空中巴士贊助，介紹標準、科技與國際合作。
body: 國際民航組織（ICAO）11月17日宣佈，在加拿大蒙特婁總部博物館推出新的航空安全展覽。展期一年，由空中巴士贊助，透過互動展示及實例，說明航空安全如何受惠於國際合作、科技與共同標準。
展覽介紹過去80年建立的航安基礎及未來發展，呼應 ICAO 長期策略計畫：在2050年實現人人可及的航空運輸、零死亡與淨零碳排。這些是長期願景，並非目前已達成的成果。
ICAO 表示，導覽行程已可透過官網預約；一般民眾亦可於指定開放時段參觀博物館。展覽以航空安全推廣為主，展示產業如何持續提升安全水準。

en.title: ICAO opens Montreal aviation safety exhibition focused on zero-fatality vision
en.summary: A year-long, Airbus-sponsored exhibition at ICAO headquarters explores the standards, technology and cooperation behind aviation safety.
body: ICAO announced a new aviation safety exhibition at the museum in its Montreal headquarters on November 17. Sponsored by Airbus, the year-long display uses interactive exhibits and practical examples to explain the role of international cooperation, technology and effective safety standards.

It examines the foundations developed over the past eighty years and the pathways to further improvements. The initiative accompanies implementation of ICAO’s long-term strategic plan, which envisions accessible air transport for all by 2050, with zero fatalities and net-zero carbon emissions. These remain long-term goals.

ICAO said guided tours can now be booked through its website. The museum will also offer public visiting periods without reservations. The exhibition promotes continued safety improvements across the aviation community.

facts.claim: ICAO launched a year-long safety exhibition at its Montreal headquarters museum, sponsored by Airbus.
The exhibition explores aviation safety foundations developed over eighty years through cooperation, technology and standards.
ICAO’s strategic plan envisions air transport for all by 2050, with zero fatalities and net-zero carbon emissions; guided tours can be booked online.
